title: YouTube App Not Working on Your New Apple TV? Here's the Fix
content:
The fourth-generation Apple TV 4K began arriving to customers today, and some users noticed the YouTube app is not working. If you have encountered this issue, make sure tvOS 27.2 is installed via Settings → System → Software Updates. If it already is, you may need to restart the Apple TV via Settings → System → Restart. Last, you may need to uninstall and reinstall the YouTube app.

Update: YouTube appears to have implemented a server-side fix.
